test_cases.name: no_plan_suggests_plan
test_cases.input: /implement (không có plan, thay đổi lớn: thêm module thanh toán)
assertions: Stops and suggests /plan, or /intent for a larger change with no plan
Does NOT start coding

test_cases.name: tiny_request_runs_directly
test_cases.input: /implement đổi tên biến userCnt thành userCount trong một file
assertions: Treats the chat message as the single task with no plan
Implements directly in this session with no subagents
Uses superpowers:test-driven-development when a test applies

test_cases.name: accepted_t0_intent_valid_input
assertions: Accepts the T0 intent as input in place of a plan
Implements it as a single task

test_cases.name: reclassify_when_tiny_grows
test_cases.input: /implement (đang làm Tiny/Quick, phát hiện cần thêm acceptance criteria và đụng 5 file)
assertions: Stops and reclassifies to T1
Writes an intent if none is accepted, then runs /spec
Does NOT continue implementing

test_cases.name: asks_method_and_workspace_with_recommended_first
assertions: Asks method and workspace in one question round
Lists `subagent-driven (Recommended)` before `inline`, and `current branch (Recommended)` before `new worktree`
Does NOT pick silently

test_cases.name: main_branch_warning
test_cases.input: /implement plan khi branch hiện tại là main
assertions: States in the `current branch` option that it commits to the default branch

test_cases.name: reuses_method_from_plan_session
test_cases.input: /implement (session vừa chọn inline ở /plan, user nói làm trên current branch)
assertions: Uses the method chosen at /plan and the stated workspace without asking again

test_cases.name: routes_to_matching_superpowers_skill
assertions: Invokes superpowers:subagent-driven-development for subagent-driven
Invokes superpowers:executing-plans for inline
Passes the workspace choice so the skill does not ask again

test_cases.name: ui_task_follows_build_stage
test_cases.input: /implement plan có task UI và spec có ## Design
assertions: Follows the Build stage of .agents/.commands/impeccable.md for every UI task before its task review
Records the Evidence: list under the task in the plan file
Stops a deviation from ## Design and routes it through /update-spec instead of changing code silently

test_cases.name: stops_before_finishing_branch
assertions: Stops where the skill would invoke finishing-a-development-branch
Does NOT merge, push, open a PR, or discard
Reports branch/worktree, tasks completed, and anything left open, and suggests /verify <plan path>
